verdict.rationale: Moss repeatedly claims sub-10ms search latency, and its homepage offers a "Run a Latency Test" feature, which suggests a first-party way to measure latency. However, the pack contains no published benchmark results, methodology, or recall figures to back the claim. Missing for 10: published benchmark reports with methodology and hardware/dataset details, measured recall/accuracy numbers, latency percentiles (p50/p99), independent or hands-on corroboration of the sub-10ms claim, and documentation of what the latency test actually measures.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims

citations.quote: Get <10 ms search with no vector databases and no latency bottlenecks.
